publisher: Borough of Prospect Park (parcel-based zoning, Passaic County GIS network, Maplink_GenCode)
notes: Last resort: a parcel layer (PAMS_PIN, BLOCK, LOT) whose ZONE attribute carries each parcel's zoning district for Prospect Park borough (MUN code 1610; only Prospect Park codes in layer). Districts include R-1, R-2, B-C, B-G-1, B-G-2, VCR, P-LWO and two redevelopment areas. No zone_name or ordinance link field. Hosted by a vendor for Passaic County GIS parcel network.
